dataset: UCI Bank Marketing - bank-additional-full.csv (Portuguese bank term-deposit telemarketing, May 2008 - Nov 2010; Kaggle: henriqueyamahata/bank-marketing)
units: contacts / calls (no money columns in source)

shot_config.cost_proxy: calls_per_conversion = SUM(campaign calls) / conversions (no money columns in source)
shot_config.dedup_rule: exact duplicate records (all 21 fields) collapsed; contact_id = ROW_NUMBER over all fields
shot_config.leakage_note: duration is known only after the call: used for descriptive talk-time only
shot_config.sample_rule: every 600th record in file order (68 contacts, all 21 columns)

shot_queries.conversion_by_age: SELECT age_band, contacts, conversion_rate_pct, lift FROM a_conv_by_age ORDER BY age_band
shot_queries.conversion_by_job_top5: SELECT job, contacts, conversion_rate_pct, calls_per_conversion FROM a_conv_by_job ORDER BY conversion_rate_pct DESC, job LIMIT 5
shot_queries.conversion_by_calls: SELECT calls_band, contacts, conversion_rate_pct, calls_per_conversion FROM a_conv_by_calls ORDER BY calls_band
shot_queries.conversion_by_prev_outcome: SELECT prev_label, contacts, conversion_rate_pct FROM a_conv_by_prev_outcome ORDER BY prev_label
shot_queries.conversion_by_channel: SELECT channel_label, contacts, conversion_rate_pct, calls_per_conversion FROM a_conv_by_channel ORDER BY channel_label
shot_queries.conversion_by_euribor: SELECT euribor_band, contacts, conversion_rate_pct FROM a_conv_by_economy ORDER BY euribor_band

stg_contacts.select: age, job, marital, education, `default` AS credit_default, housing, loan AS personal_loan, contact AS contact_channel, `month` AS contact_month, day_of_week, duration, campaign, pdays, previous, poutcome, `emp.var.rate` AS emp_var_rate, `cons.price.idx` AS cons_price_idx, `cons.conf.idx` AS cons_conf_idx, euribor3m, `nr.employed` AS nr_employed, y
